instruction: Use the FreeCAD 1.1.1 GUI with the Path/CAM workbench. Open or import the initial CAD geometry file(s) from the Desktop path(s): /home/user/Desktop/part_with_vise.step. Create a FreeCAD Path/CAM Job. Keep the vise jaws visible in the project as check geometry. Create machining boundaries for the two top pockets that avoid the fixture regions. Every low-level toolpath point must keep at least 3 mm clearance from the fixture. Tool definition: T1 is an 8 mm end mill for the two top pockets while avoiding the vise jaws. Use the Job, stock/setup, origin, ToolBit/ToolController, operation, toolpath verification, and Path postprocessor dialogs as needed. Post the required G-code/NC output file(s) to the output folder using exactly these absolute file paths: /home/user/Desktop/task-11.nc.
